summary: Timezone-driven metering window shift produced negative provisional credit on invoice
description: Issue summary: Customer LumenAI reported a negative provisional credit on their hourly invoice after a region-wide metering-window adjustment. Impact: Customer-facing billing shows a -$18.40 provisional credit line (negative credit) for hour 2026-03-09T07:00-08:00 which the customer says should not exist. Environment: Dedicated tenant on prod-us-west, reserved capacity, using redwood-7b-v1. Steps to reproduce: 1) Query billing UI for 2026-03-09 hourly invoice lines for LumenAI. 2) Inspect postback logs for postback_batch_id 20260309-07A. 3) Compare metering namespace tags and probe-tag classification. Observed behavior: A mix of probe-tagged (internal) pings and customer traffic were re-tagged during a metering-window timezone shift reaggregation run; reaggregation created a negative provisional credit adjustment that appeared on the customer's invoice. Expected behavior: Internal probe traffic should be excluded from customer invoices; reaggregation runs should never create negative credits without an accompanying audit entry and reason code. Logs and pointers: Billing line id: BL-20260309-07A (customer UI). Postback logs: s3://billing-logs/prod/us-west/2026-03-09/postbacks/20260309-07A.json. Reaggregation job: job-run-9876 (see PR link).
comments: 2026-03-10 10:02 - Asha Menon: Customer reported via email. Customer believes a system reaggregation introduced a negative provisional credit applied to their finalized hourly invoice line. They provided screenshot and CSV export.

2026-03-10 11:20 - Jordan Patel: Acknowledged, set ticket to P1. Asked for postback_batch_id and invoice line id. Requested internal runbook for reaggregation jobs. Added linked issues for SRE to triage INT-428.

2026-03-11 09:45 - SRE (Morgan Lee): Found that reaggregation job job-run-9876 executed a timezone normalization pass between 07:00-08:00 and merged probe-tagged postbacks into the customer namespace due to tag-scope mismatch during daylight savings boundary simulation. Marking hypothesis: probe annotation lost during re-tagging.

2026-03-12 08:30 - Billing (Riley Gomez): Confirmed the negative provisional credit was created as an adjuster record with reason_code: REAGG_WINDOW_SHIFT. No automated audit comment was attached. Preparing corrective reversal and audit entry if customer approves waiver.
2026-03-12 12:05 - Customer (LumenAI - Hana Park): Requests immediate reversal and explanation. Concerned about controls to prevent this in future.
2026-03-12 15:22 - Jordan Patel: Scheduled follow-up call with LumenAI for 2026-03-13. Preparing rollback and patch plan; see investigation notes.
investigation_notes: Checked postback processor metrics: spike in re-tag operations at 2026-03-09T07:12:00Z correlated with job-run-9876 start.
Queryed postback database: 213 internal-probe postbacks were missing probe_tag=true after normalization pass; 107 of those were merged into org_id=LumenAI due to fallback mapping rule.

Hypothesis: timezone normalization routine incorrectly applied a fallback tag map for timestamps ambiguous across DST simulation test in staging; fallback map defaulted to primary org tag when probe metadata absent.
Ran local replay on a copy of postbacks: replayed job-run-9876 with patched tag-check prevented the negative adjuster creation; provisional credit not produced in replay.

Cross-check with billing engine: adjuster record created because the hourly accumulator saw net negative delta when subtracting removed probe tokens post-reaggregation. Billing engine currently permits negative provisional adjusters to surface as negative credits to maintain ledger parity — policy decision.
workaround: Immediate workaround: Flag job-run-9876 affected invoices as 'manual-review' and generate a reversal adjuster (billing will create a positive offset) pending full audit. Prevent further reaggregation runs on tenant LumenAI until patch deployed. Technical workaround: block timestamp normalization path that triggers fallback tag mapping for ambiguous timestamps.
resolution_notes: 2026-03-12: Billing created reversal adjuster to offset -$18.40 and added audit comment referencing SUP-991357. Customer billing UI updated; reversal will appear on next hourly refresh.

2026-03-12: Engineering backported patch to postback normalization that preserves explicit probe_tag when present and prevents fallback-to-org mapping for ambiguous timestamps. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/usage-postback/pull/748 merged to main.

2026-03-12: SRE scheduled a backfill run to reprocess affected batch with patched logic; outcome will be validated against ledger before finalizing reversal. Postback pipeline instrumentation will now emit 'reagg_audit' events when re-tagging changes namespace.
Follow-up: Update runbook to ensure reaggregation jobs add explicit audit entries when any cross-namespace reclassification occurs. Add test for DST/ambiguous timestamp path.
resolution: Pending - reversal applied and patch merged; awaiting backfill validation and customer confirmation
